name: Ran→Sem ~Hakudaku Delmo Tsuma no Miira Tori~
original_name: Ran→Sem～白濁デルモ妻のミイラ捕り～
source:
One day, Anna goes missing. Riko, her older sister, looks for her, but she doesn't know where Anna has gone.... Days later, Riko meets a woman in town. Her name is Naomi, whose fiance is also missing after he entered a self enlightenment group.... Riko and Naomi decide to join the group to save them....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
一天，Anna失踪了。姐姐Riko四处寻找，却不知道她去了哪里…几天后，Riko在城里遇见一名叫Naomi的女子。Naomi的未婚夫加入一个自我启发团体后同样失踪…Riko与Naomi决定加入该团体，营救两人…

[摘自ErogeShop]
